text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Could I have done a little better, I 
wonder...? Tonight's stream will be a 
reflection session, then.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
It's not a bad result by any means. I want 
you to think of it as having even more 
room to grow.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"That's right, Love-chan. That just means 
you have room to grow even more from here 
on out."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thank you, Maru-chan. Let's do our 
best for Casino-san too♪

Let's devise a training policy for the 
next season to make the most of the 
atmosphere within the team.
